runs.superseded: Superseded 2026-09-22 by the first-party row (18/105, effort explicitly asserted). This row ran at `default` over an aggregator hop - the aggregator's reasoning dial is accepted but measured inert, so `default` never named a state that could be asked for again. The first-party row asserts the model's one real toggle (`thinking.type=enabled`) explicitly and drops the aggregator hop entirely; it scored 2 points lower (18 vs 20), inside the noise this board has already measured elsewhere (widest observed spread: 6 of 105) and expected here since both rows almost certainly ran with reasoning already on. Nothing here is retracted - the 20 happened and this is its receipt - but it is no longer the row that best answers whether reasoning is on for this model. The OpenRouter route itself was also independently replicated: see 'MiMo-V2.6-Pro - mean of 2' (mean of two runs, 22.0 of 105) for the same-route, same-configuration successor. This row is superseded on two separate axes - route (the first-party row) and sample size (the mean row) - neither displacing the other.

runs.superseded: Superseded 2026-09-14 by the n=3 MEAN row at the same rung (13/105). This row is ONE run of three, and it is the lowest of the three: medium scored 9, 15 and 15 on identical runs, and low scored 12, 13 and 4. THREE CLAIMS IN THE NOTE BELOW ARE RETRACTED. (1) 'Nearly the same money for less than half the result' - at the mean it is 13 against high's 19 for 9.24 dollars against 10.81. Cheaper and worse, but not half. (2) '1 dollar 11 per fix, the worst buy by a factor of two' - the mean is 71 cents per fix, mid-pack. (3) 'Reasoning volume does not explain it, medium emitted MORE than high' - the medium mean is 149,769 reasoning tokens against high's 178,300, so that inversion was one verbose run, not a property of the tier. TWO CLAIMS SURVIVE. On repo 2 medium still costs MORE in absolute dollars than high at the mean, 5.05 against 3.98, for 8 of 60 against 11 of 60. And the pre-registered branch still stands: 13 is still well below 19, so the dial does move score at the bottom while high-to-xhigh stays dead in the middle - it fired on a 10-point margin and the real one is 6.
